plan.fit_summary: Tier A fit: DACHSER, headquartered in Kempten, Germany [2], operates a Food Logistics segment that 'continues to expand' [5] and runs an 'Integrity in Logistics Compliance reporting system' [3], matching ColdTrace's temperature-monitoring and audit-report ICP.

who.why: Owns the segment that 'continues to expand' [5]; wireless temperature sensors and automatic audit reports serve exactly this temperature-controlled operation.
DACHSER maintains an 'Integrity in Logistics Compliance reporting system' [3]; automated audit reports cut the manual effort behind such compliance documentation.

plan.hook: DACHSER's Food Logistics 'continues to expand' [5] — every added food route and warehouse increases the temperature-documentation and audit workload that ColdTrace automates.
plan.channel: Phone call first to the Food Logistics or Quality Management team. DACHSER is headquartered in Kempten, Germany [2]; German law (UWG § 7 (2) no. 2) requires prior express consent for electronic mail, also in B2B, and courts treat social-network messages as electronic mail. A call about temperature monitoring for their food logistics operations falls within the recipient's trade, so presumed consent is plausible; a letter is the alternative. Use the email draft only after consent or send it as a letter. Not legal advice.
avoid: Do not allege temperature-monitoring gaps or audit failures at DACHSER — no source documents any; frame ColdTrace as support for growth instead.
Do not present the Drummond acquisition as food or temperature-controlled business — it concerns groupage for industrial and consumer goods [6].
Do not open with a cold email or LinkedIn/XING message — the company is Germany-based [2], so electronic mail requires prior express consent.
questions: How is temperature data currently recorded and compiled into audit reports across your Food Logistics warehouses and transports?

draft.subject: Temperaturdokumentation im Wachstum
draft.body:
Guten Tag,

Ihr Geschäftsbereich Food Logistics expandiert laut Ihrer Unternehmenskommunikation weiterhin [5]. Jede zusätzliche Lebensmittelroute und jedes neue Lager erhöht häufig den Aufwand für Temperaturdokumentation und Auditberichte. Mit unseren drahtlosen Temperatursensoren und automatisierten Auditberichten unterstützen wir Sie genau dabei. Ist das bei Ihnen gerade ein Thema?

Viele Grüße
[Sender]
